record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Classify the possible asymptotic growth types of Betti-number sequences over quotient rings, and determine whether only polynomial and exponential growth can occur.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(R,\mathfrak{m},k)$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring (for instance a quotient $R = Q/I$ of a regular local ring $Q$ by an ideal $I$), and let $M$ be a finitely generated $R$-module. For $i \ge 0$, let $\beta_i^R(M) = \dim_k \operatorname{Tor}_i^R(M,k)$ denote the $i$-th Betti number of $M$ over $R$. The sequence $\{\beta_i^R(M)\}_{i \ge 0}$ is said to have polynomial growth of degree $d$ if there exist positive constants $c_1, c_2$ and an integer $d \ge 0$ such that $c_1 i^d \le \beta_i^R(M) \le c_2 i^d$ for all sufficiently large $i$, and to have exponential growth if there exist real numbers $1 < a \le b$ such that $a^i \le \beta_i^R(M) \le b^i$ for all sufficiently large $i$.

Classify the possible asymptotic growth types of Betti-number sequences $\{\beta_i^R(M)\}$ over local rings $R$ as $M$ ranges over finitely generated $R$-modules. In particular, determine whether the only possible asymptotic behaviors are polynomial growth and exponential growth, i.e., whether intermediate growth (slower than every exponential but faster than every polynomial) can occur.
artifact.category_tag: Betti number growth over local rings
artifact.status_search_result: The dichotomy question (only polynomial or exponential growth of Betti numbers, ruling out intermediate growth) is a long-standing open problem in commutative algebra, going back to Avramov. Recent work (e.g., McCormick 2022/2024 on arXiv:2208.04770 about polynomial growth of Betti sequences over local rings, and subsequent works on derived complete intersections, 2024–2025) continues to address partial cases but does not resolve the general classification. No source found establishing or refuting the dichotomy in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Polynomial growth of Betti sequences over local rings
status_evidence.snippet: Studies when Betti sequences grow polynomially over local rings, extending Gulliksen-type characterizations; partial progress on classifying growth.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial progress on polynomial growth of Betti sequences; the general dichotomy is not settled.

status_evidence.title: Derived complete intersections and polynomial growth of Betti numbers over dg-algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Extends Gulliksen's theorem characterizing polynomial growth of Betti numbers to differential graded algebras.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing research continues to refine when polynomial growth occurs, indicating the classification problem remains active.
